description_en: Creates an application and binds it to a specified image version
description_zh: 创建应用，并将应用绑定到指定镜像版本
name: CreateAndBindApp

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to be created, which is used to identify the application in the image
parameters.help_zh: 创建的应用名称，用于在镜像中识别该应用
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The URL of the application icon. Specify an accessible icon URL when a custom icon needs to be displayed
parameters.help_zh: 应用图标的 URL。需要显示自定义图标时填写可访问的图标地址
parameters.name: app_icon_url

parameters.help_en: The service port of the application. For applications that require port-based access, specify the actual port number that the application listens on
parameters.help_zh: 应用服务端口。用于需要通过端口访问的应用，填写应用实际监听的端口号
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The path suffix of the application access URL, which describes the access entry point together with the application service port
parameters.help_zh: 应用访问 URL 的路径后缀，与应用服务端口共同描述访问入口
parameters.name: url_suffix

parameters.help_en:
The application form. If omitted, the default value is CLIENT_BASE. Valid values:

CLIENT_BASE: client application
WEB_BASE: browser application
CLOUD_NATIVE_BASE: cloud-native application
PORT_SERVICE_BASE: port service application
AGENT_SERVICE_BASE: agent application
parameters.help_zh:
应用形态。省略时为 CLIENT_BASE。可选值：

CLIENT_BASE：客户端应用。
WEB_BASE：浏览器应用。
CLOUD_NATIVE_BASE：云原生应用。
PORT_SERVICE_BASE：端口服务应用。
AGENT_SERVICE_BASE：Agent 应用
parameters.name: origin_app_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image to which the application is bound. The image must be a custom image or community image that can be managed by the current account
parameters.help_zh: 绑定应用的镜像 ID。镜像必须属于当前账号可管理的自定义镜像或社区镜像
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image version to which the application is bound. If omitted, the current active version of the image specified by ImageId is used. If specified, the version must belong to the image
parameters.help_zh: 绑定应用的镜像版本 ID。省略时使用 ImageId 对应镜像的当前生效版本；指定时必须属于该镜像
parameters.name: version_id

schema.description_en: The response of this API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Code.description_en: The error code. This field is returned when the request fails and may not be included in a successful response
Code.description_zh: 错误码。请求失败时返回；成功响应可能不包含该字段

Data.description_en: The business data returned by this operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务数据

AppId.description_en: The application ID, used for subsequent application queries or to dissociate the application from the image
AppId.description_zh: 应用 ID，用于后续查询应用或解除镜像绑定

AppVersionId.description_en: The application version ID, used to locate a specified version of the application. This field is not the image version ID
AppVersionId.description_zh: 应用版本 ID，用于定位应用的指定版本。此字段不是镜像版本 ID

ImageId.description_en: The image ID, used for subsequent image queries or modifications
ImageId.description_zh: 镜像 ID，用于后续查询或修改镜像

VersionId.description_en: The image version ID, used to query or manage a specified version of the image
VersionId.description_zh: 镜像版本 ID，用于查询或操作该镜像的指定版本

Message.description_en: The error or result message. This field describes the cause when the request fails and may not be included in a successful response
Message.description_zh: 错误或结果提示。请求失败时用于说明原因，成功响应可能不包含该字段

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can provide this value for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，排查问题时可提供该值

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. A value of true indicates that the request was processed successfully. To check whether an asynchronous task is completed, query the task status separately
Success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步任务是否完成须另外查询任务状态
